text:
anya: quick flag — the new rollout slice on the latency dashboard shows p99 smaller than p50 for /v1/generate in the eu-west region :thinking:
kevin: screenshot pls
anya: https://img.example/shot123 (small table pasted) p50=120ms, p95=120ms, p99=95ms for slice=canary-0.2
morgan: that ordering can't be right unless samples are different sets or units got mixed
taylor: could be two sources merged? client-side vs server-side latencies with different tags collapsing into same series name
anya: i pulled the raw series via the console query: ```metrics.query("latency", endpoint="/v1/generate", slice="canary-0.2", region="eu-west")``` and it returned two sample origins: transport_time (ms) and backend_proc (s) — looks like a unit mismatch that got coerced during rollup
kevin: ah, backend_proc in seconds -> 0.095s becomes 95ms and then tdigest merge produced weird quantiles when samples are weight-merged across origins
morgan: tdigest merging across mixed units will definitely produce inverted quantiles. We should reject merges when unit tag differs or normalize units before aggregation
taylor: agreed. UX question: how do we present this in the dashboard so PMs don't get alarmed? Right now the rollout UI shows a tiny red p99 drop which looks like improved perf
anya: propose: show a provenance badge on the quantile line that lists sample origins (transport_time, backend_proc) and a tooltip warning if units differ. Also make rollouts default to 'same-origin-only' for pctl comparisons
morgan: +1. Also add an automated check in the merge path that emits an alert when unit inconsistency > 2x detected (and optionally hide quantiles until normalized)
kevin: implementation-wise, we can add a simple unit-normalizer when ingesting: if metric_name == "latency" and unit tag present, convert to ms before tdigest. But we need a fallback for missing unit tags
taylor: for missing units, use provenance sampling: look at typical magnitude per origin and infer unit (heuristic). But annotate inferred ones as "unit_inferred"
anya: ok, short-term action items:
- kevin: add unit-normalizer patch to ingestion (PR by EOD)
- morgan: add console tooltip & badge mockups (design link)
- taylor: add rollout UX opt-in for "same-origin-only" comparisons
- metrics-bot: create a daily check that scans pctl anomalies where p99 < p50 and posts findings to #eng-platform-incidents
anya: thanks — this explains a bunch of confusion from yesterday's canary. i'm going to update the incident notes
metrics-bot: automated-scan: found 3 slices in the last 24h with p99 < p50; first hit: endpoint=/v1/generate slice=canary-0.2 region=eu-west
kevin: will follow up with a quick PR and ping here when in staging
morgan: thanks everyone, this was a subtle one. :thumbsup:
